description: Revert to the larger global batch size (2^19) to maximize throughput and effective learning rate per unit time, while keeping the successful 8-layer/128-dim architecture and the optimized Muon learning rate (0.035) and weight decay (0.21) from the best run, as the previous OOM was likely due to the specific memory fragmentation of the smaller batch size combined with FA3 overheads rather than the batch size itself.
